about: The Caribbean’s most famous carnival, from the pre-dawn J’ouvert mud and paint party on Monday to the costumed “pretty mas” parades on Tuesday.

about: Trinidad’s large Indian community celebrates the Hindu festival of lights with thousands of clay deyas, and Divali Nagar hosts a week of culture and food.
Trinidad’ın büyük Hint topluluğu Hindu ışık bayramını binlerce kil deya ile kutlar; Divali Nagar bir hafta boyunca kültür ve yemek etkinlikleri düzenler.
Die große indischstämmige Gemeinschaft Trinidads feiert das Lichterfest mit Tausenden Ton-Deyas; im Divali Nagar gibt es eine Woche Kultur und Essen.
La gran comunidad india de Trinidad celebra la fiesta de las luces con miles de deyas de barro, y Divali Nagar ofrece una semana de cultura y comida.
